title: Reyes Cup MVP 'just a bonus' for Sánchez Ruíz after Team ROW's breakthrough
summary: Francisco Sánchez Ruíz placed team success above individual recognition after winning the Most Valuable Player award while leading Team Rest of the World to the 2026 Reyes Cup title.
